entries.bf85fbe915db2e40: It is a power electronics manufacturer headquartered in Higashiyodogawa-ku, Osaka. The group consists of nine subsidiaries and one associated company, and the consolidated number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 1,399. The company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.d00a3ee10985b1f8: It is a power electronics manufacturer headquartered in Higashiyodogawa-ku, Osaka.
entries.dd3112f26daac790: This is a reportable segment that manufactures and sells DC power supplies, power supplies for surface treatment, AC uninterruptible power supply units, power supplies for motor control, power supplies for electric furnaces, dimmers, power supplies for light source equipment, washing machines, arc welding machines, dental equipment, AC power supply units and other products. In addition to the company, Sansha Electric (Guangdong) Co., Ltd., Suwa Sansha Electric Co., Ltd. and Osaka Densō Kōgyō Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell these products, and sales subsidiaries such as Sanrex Corporation sell them. Installation and commissioning, repair, maintenance and construction contracting of equipment are handled by Sansha Solution Service Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥20,283 million.
